glossary.def: A decision only the captain makes: options, one recommended.
Something that will be different once built.
A blanket term for four things. Say which one.
What a screen will look like, before it is built.

quiz.question: Which of these is a mockup?
options: A drawing of a screen before building
A flow of how each answer travels
A bar chart of tokens spent per board
quiz.why: A mockup shows a screen before it is built; the flow is a diagram and the bars a chart.

quiz.question: Where does firstmate read your picks from?
options: The saved store, one record per call
The page itself, read back as HTML
The chat, after you paste them in
quiz.why: Firstmate reads the store, never the page; pasting is only the fallback.
